queries.We will develop Ukiyo-e-Seq, an integrat: paired optical microscopy and single-cell RNA sequencing workflow for individual uncultured eukaryotic plankton linking organismal appearance to transcriptomic function
queries.We will use microscope-mounted cell pick: microscope-mounted cell picker imaging brightfield and epifluorescence channels and transferring selected eukaryotic plankton with glass capillaries into microtiter plate wells for paired optical and single-cell transcriptomic analysis
queries.We will prepare libraries for single-wel: Smart-seq2 single-well RNA sequencing library preparation in 384-well microtiter plates for individual captured eukaryotic plankton cells and single-cell transcriptomics
queries.Libraries will be sequenced on Illumina: Illumina NextSeq 500 paired-end 300 bp sequencing of Smart-seq2 single-well RNA libraries from captured eukaryotic plankton at 250,000 read pairs per well for single-cell transcriptomics
queries.We will develop a merge-split strategy t: merge-split de novo transcriptome assembly for single-well RNA sequencing of uncultured oceanic eukaryotic plankton without species-specific reference genomes, pooling reads to build a common reference and aligning individual well reads to contigs for expression profiling
queries.We will filter reads using Trimmomatic a: Quality control of raw single-cell RNA sequencing reads using Trimmomatic and custom removal of template switch oligo sequences and sequencing artifacts before de novo transcriptome assembly and expression analysis of eukaryotic plankton
queries.We will use rnaSpades for de novo assemb: rnaSpades de novo assembly and merge-split alignment of single-well RNA-seq reads from eukaryotic plankton to build a contig-by-well expression matrix without reference genomes
queries.We will perform taxonomic classification: Kraken 2 taxonomic classification of single-well eukaryotic plankton transcriptomes using large metagenomic and metatranscriptomic reference databases to assign taxonomic identity when species-specific reference genomes are unavailable
queries.We will identify open reading frames (OR: functional annotation of open reading frames in de novo transcriptome contigs using NCBI ORF finder to extract KEGG photosystem I and II pathway components and connect eukaryotic plankton transcriptomes to biochemical capabilities
queries.We will demonstrate our method by collec: pilot environmental sampling of ocean water from Wiley's Baths near Coogee using plankton nets to test single-cell optical and transcriptomic workflow on real eukaryotic plankton communities
queries.We will process samples through tea siev: Sample preparation of ocean water eukaryotic plankton using tea sieves and filter paper size selection, centrifugation, and sedimentation to isolate organisms between 25 micrometers and 1 millimeter for single-cell picking and transcriptomics.
queries.Using the microscope-mounted cell picker: Microscope-mounted cell picker imaging and capture of 66 single eukaryotic plankton organisms into microtiter wells plus negative controls for validating single-organism RNA sequencing
queries.We will confirm successful picking with: post-capture brightfield images for quality control of successful single eukaryotic plankton picking and microtiter well identity before single-cell RNA sequencing
queries.We will visualize expression patterns of: Visualizing top highly expressed contigs from single-well RNA sequencing to identify public shared community transcripts and private organism-specific transcripts in eukaryotic plankton metatranscriptomics
queries.We will assess taxonomic composition acr: Ecological analysis of single-well marine plankton transcriptomes for taxonomic composition across superkingdoms and individual well phylogenies to assess taxonomic resolution and community coexistence patterns.
queries.We will focus on photosynthetic organism: single-organism transcriptome functional annotation of photosynthetic eukaryotic plankton using KEGG photosystem I/II open reading frames to infer photosynthetic capability
queries.We will use AlphaFold 3 to predict three: AlphaFold 3 prediction of three-dimensional protein complex structures from single-cell transcriptomic open reading frames in individual marine eukaryotic plankton, extending functional annotation of photosystem proteins to protein-complex architecture
queries.For developmental analysis, we will exam: developmental transcriptomic workflow for non-photosynthetic eukaryotic plankton using highly expressed de novo contigs from fish egg and larva samples to identify novel cell cycle and embryonic development proteins
